<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.37.0 -->

## What's Changed
### New Features 🎉
* Stacking options - `st.bar_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8945
* Support `graphviz.sources.Source` object for `st.graphviz_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8993
* Add support for material icons in markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8889
* Fix lag when closing dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9023
* Stacking options - `st.area_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8992
* Add feedback widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8915
* READ only headers and cookies by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8976
* De-experimentalize st.fragment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9019
* De-experimentalize st.dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9020
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Show fragment errors in fragment-path for main app runs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8868
* Fix st.rerun fragment thread reuse issue by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8798
* Support non-unix style paths for MPA loading by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8988
* Set theme hash properly on load if a custom theme is active to start by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8989
* Don't remove session refs on fragment runs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9010
* Improvements to NumberInput formatting by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9035
* Hide all Particles upon printing by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9053
* Fix: MPA support of custom themes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8994
* `st.switch_page` clears non-embed query params  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9059
* Fix secrets.toml Windows Path Bug by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9061
* Bugfix: Fixes two st.map width bugs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9070
* Validate the path using Tornado before performing checks by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8990
* Reset ctx.current_fragment_id to last ID instead of None by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9114
### Other Changes
* Update emojis used for validation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8923
* Add support for numpy 2.x by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8940
* Remove a bunch of deprecated experimental features by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8943
* Migrate custom icons from material outlined to rounded by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8998
* Remove old config options - part 1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9005
* Remove old config options - part 2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9013
* Remove `deprecation.showPyplotGlobalUse` config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9018
* Fix broken `st.navigation` docstring by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9027
* Update the feedback widget design by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9094

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8947
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/8968
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9027

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.36.0...1.37.0
